purpose: The ingredients of every prescription in docs/Seed Dataset.md, as DDInter names them. Add these to your data/build/drug-scope.json, rebuild the index with your own DDInter scripts (build-interaction-index.js, then build-demo-index.js), and copy the resulting demo index over data/interaction-index.json. `npm run coverage` then reports which seed drugs the index covers. Nothing in this file is interaction data.

seedIngredients.name: Atorvastatin
seedPrescriptions: rx-004 (discontinued - not screened, listed for completeness)

seedIngredients.name: Ciprofloxacin
seedPrescriptions: rx-007 (returned to clinic - excluded until confirmed)

brandCandidates.note: Seed brand names that are NOT in your SFDA brand map (MAREVAN is already in its pendingVerification). Suggestions only - nothing here is loaded. To add one, filter the SFDA drugs list by its scientific name, copy the trade name verbatim into brand-map.json and set verified:true.
